title: One agent action through AI Intents
lede: An action's text is embedded by the encoder sidecar, scored against the app's selected intents, filtered by each intent's Floor, checked against twin intents, and allowed or denied by the matched intent's Acts flag. The lab's own reading of each step is on the trail.

nodes.label: Agent action (text)
sub: e.g. move 200 dollars from checking to savings

steps.title: The action arrives
steps.what: The agent's action is text: 'move 200 dollars from checking to savings'. It carries no intent label of its own — the purpose must be resolved.

steps.title: The app scopes the intents
steps.what: modelAIIntentConfig lists which intents apply to this app. An app that selects none has no intent resolution at all: the lab denies it fail-closed.

steps.title: The encoder embeds the text
steps.what: The sidecar turns the text into a 384-dimension vector over the KServe v2 wire. The lab's model is a hashed character-trigram stand-in, not a trained encoder.

steps.title: Score against exemplars
steps.what: The vector is compared with every exemplar of every in-scope intent; the best cosine similarity is the intent's score.

steps.title: Each Floor filters its own intent
steps.what: A score under an intent's Spec.Floor takes that intent out. What floor the real product applies and how is UNVERIFIED — the lab's rule is stated on the trail.

steps.title: Twins are told apart
steps.what: If the top two survivors are declared twins of each other and sit within 0.05, the lab refuses rather than guesses: money must not move on a coin flip.

steps.title: Acts decides the last step
steps.what: The matched intent's Spec.Acts is the lab's stand-in for 'this intent authorizes action'. False (a describing intent like check-balance) denies a write-shaped action.
